'''Caria Haal''' was the [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Governor/Legends|governor]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Spintir/Legends|Spintir]]. She was corrupt, and used her position to get funding for the [[University of Reles]], and house her personal collection of relics in a secure wing of its [[Museum of Spintir]]. Most of the funding the university received was diverted to provide security for her collection. Her collection included a [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]].<ref name="LotL" />
